items.title: CNN removed from Trump press pool despite judge order to reinstate White House access
items.standfirst: US news outlet CNN has been removed from a press pool that is accompanying President Donald Trump on a trip to Tennessee on Saturday. Last week, the Trump administration barred CNN, along with MS NOW and Politico, from accessing the White House. A judge then ordered their access temporarily restored, saying the move was likely unconstitutional.

A judge then ordered their access temporarily restored, saying the move was likely unconstitutional.

items.title: US Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial voter 'verification' system
items.standfirst: The US Supreme Court on Friday ruled the Trump administration can use a controversial new federal database that would ostensibly verify voter citizenship in November’s elections. Critics argue the administration is exaggerating the threat of non-citizen voters – an extreme rarity in US elections – to implement policies that would disenfranchise likely Democratic voters.
